description: Jack Modular Connector RJ45 Through Hole
designVerdict: REJECTED - the RJ45 and its magnetics are on the W5500 module (see C134462).
notes: RJ45 with integrated magnetics, the standard pairing for a W5500. $1.73, stock 26k.
Through-hole. In a vibration environment it needs its shield tabs soldered and ideally a mechanical retention screw, not just the signal pins.
RETIRED with the bare W5500. The undocumented TCT/RCT centre-tap bias that made this a blocking open question is inside the module now.
